text: This candidate received an overall score of 0.2433 for the AI Software Developer position. The strongest evidence for their application is a computer science degree and 4.54 years of experience, alongside familiarity with "JavaScript", "React", and "Docker". Key gaps include the absence of required machine learning, C#, and SQL expertise, as well as missing nice-to-have skills like .NET, TypeScript, and NoSQL. The application has been escalated for further review despite the low fit and missing must-have requirements.
